items.title: Interview: U.S. firms value opportunities in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
items.summary: Many innovative companies have adopted an “in China, with China, for the world” strategy for at least part of their business, U.S.-China Business Council President Sean Stein said in an interview during APEC leaders’ week. The Greater Bay Area’s large market, innovation opportunities and efficient investment environment are highly attractive. Nearly 90% of U.S. companies say the Chinese market is important to maintaining their global competitiveness. Scope for bilateral business cooperation remains in life sciences, product safety, certification and standards compliance.

items.title: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards unveil new missile launcher
items.summary: Iranian state television aired footage on Nov. 21 showing senior Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) officials, including commander-in-chief Vahidi, at an underground missile base. The footage showed a newly developed twin launcher for the first time; it can carry and fire two liquid-fueled missiles simultaneously. Iranian media said the missiles have greater range and accuracy and can adjust their speed in flight to evade air defenses. items.title: U.S. October PCE inf seen rising to 3.8%, lifting December Fed hike bets
items.summary: U.S. consumers are expected to maintain strong spending ahead of the holiday shopping season, with inflation pressure yet to curb outlays. Economists surveyed by Bloomberg see inflation-adjusted PCE rising 0.1% MoM in October, after strong gains in each of the prior two quarters. The PCE price index is forecast to rise 3.8% YoY, while core PCE is also expected to accelerate, bolstering expectations for a December Fed rate hike. Continued job growth and resilient consumer and business activity give policymakers room to focus on inflation, even as rising prices add to pressure on the Fed.

items.summary: 【机构：美国10月PCE通胀料升至3.8%，美联储12月加息预期或升温】金十数据11月22日讯，机构分析指出，美国消费者在假日购物季到来前仍保持较强消费意愿，通胀压力暂未明显抑制支出。彭博社调查显示，经济学家预计美国10月经通胀调整后的个人消费支出环比增长0.1%，此前两个季度消费支出均实现强劲增长。与此同时，通胀压力可能进一步加剧。预计10月个人消费支出（PCE）价格指数同比上涨3.8%，接近美联储2%通胀目标的两倍。剔除食品和能源价格后的核心PCE指数预计也将加速上涨，进一步强化市场对美联储12月加息的预期。就业持续增长，消费者和企业活动保持稳健，为美联储决策者将政策重点转向应对通胀压力提供了空间。随着物价涨幅继续走高，美联储面临的政策压力也在增加。

items.summary: 【刘烈宏赴江西省调研数据要素市场化配置改革工作推进情况】金十数据11月22日讯，近日，国家数据局党组书记、局长刘烈宏带队赴江西省南昌市，实地调研江西省数字产业集团有限公司、华润江中药业股份有限公司、江西一脉阳光集团股份有限公司、江西时刻互动科技股份有限公司，并召开数字中国建设调研座谈会，深入了解地方推进数据要素市场化配置改革的问题和意见建议。调研组了解到，江西省数据要素市场化配置改革工作取得积极进展，从制度、设施、场景、市场、产业五个方面协同发力，初步构建了数据要素价值释放的闭环，将省级数据集团作为落实数据要素市场化配置改革的重要载体，积极推动“人工智能+”与“数据要素×”同频共振，有序发展词元等新业态，数据要素赋能经济社会数智化转型作用明显。调研组希望江西省深入贯彻落实“十五五”数字中国建设任务部署，以更大力度推进数字江西建设，深入推进数据要素市场化配置改革，探索形成更多具有引领性和地域辨识度的创新成果。（国家数据局）
